source_note: Labour Code of the Republic of Armenia ՀՕ-124-Ն (arlis.am redaction 23.12.2022-06.04.2023; owner confirmed current 22 Nov 2026). Quotes and article reading in docs/legal/PRE_REVIEW.md. Lawyer must confirm.
basis: Art. 172(1): 140 days (70 before, 70 after birth); 155 days for complicated birth; 180 days for more than one child.

title.hy: Հղիության և ծննդաբերության արձակուրդը նվազագույնից կարճ է
title.ru: Отпуск по беременности и родам короче минимального
title.en: Maternity leave is shorter than the minimum

edge_cases: Only the 140-day base is checked; 155/180 depend on medical facts we do not store.

Art. 172(2),(2.1): adoptive parents and surrogacy parents are entitled to less (until the newborn is 70 days old; 110 days for twins). Use the rule for women on birth leave only; do not record those cases as maternity leave.
